name: cosmo-automations
description: Cosmo Automations — a node-graph workflow automation simulation for CodeSignal Learn & Hire

scripts.start:dev: concurrently -n vite,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.reset:demo: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {defaultScenario,readJson}=require('./engine/scenarios');const s=readJson(defaultScenario().scenarioPath);fs.writeFileSync('solution.json',JSON.stringify(s.initialWorkflow,null,2));fs.rmSync('execution.json',{force:true});console.log('demo state reset: blank canvas, no trace')"
scripts.release:local: npm run build && npm run pack && node scripts/verify-release.js release.tar.gz
